text:
alex: Quick heads-up: user hit a prod-only crash when packaging our JS SDK for edge with rollup+terser. Dev server fine.

nina: reproducible? steps?

alex: minimal repro: build with rollup + terser, deploy to Cloudflare Pages, first SDK call throws `ReferenceError: Request is not defined`. Local vite dev + node ok.

rachel: suspicious: polyfill/guard for Headers/Request got removed by minifier because it lived in a conditional guard. Which bundle entry is used?

alex: rollup resolved ESM entry. The guard was behind `if (typeof Request === 'undefined') { attach() }` and terser const-folded it away. Affects retry code path only (skip when retry=0).

nina: possible workarounds for customers?

alex: advised: 1) add explicit import `import { ensureEdgeGlobals } from 'redwood/edge-shim'; ensureEdgeGlobals();` in app entry 2) for vite, add `optimizeDeps.include: ['redwood']` 3) pin `retry:0` until fixed.

rachel: SDK fix: move shim to its own module referenced by ESM export, and republish types so ESM d.ts includes retry options. Also add bundler smoke jobs.

ci-bot: created ticket RED-4510 to add rollup/webpack/vite build-smoke tests to CI.

docs: I'll add a short quickstart FAQ entry with the shim snippet.

alex: I'll open the minimal repro repo and link it to RED-4510. Thanks.
